title: xbrl CLI machine-readable result
description: Stable output of `xbrl <command> --json`. Every field is always present; absent values are null or empty arrays. Rule ids, severities and byte spans come from xbrl_core::diagnostic (XBRL 2.1 REC 2003-12-31, errata 2013-02-20). See docs/agent-tool-contract.md for the exit-code and support-state policy.

schema.description: Schema identifier. A change to any field name, ordering or value vocabulary requires a new id.

command.description: Subcommand that produced the result; `unknown` is used when the command line failed before a known subcommand was identified.

status.description: ok: completed with no error-severity diagnostic. findings: completed with at least one error-severity diagnostic. error: could not complete.

exit_code.description: 0 ok, 1 findings, 2 usage error, 4 input error.

diagnostics.description: All retained findings in deterministic order; empty when none were emitted.

diagnostics_truncated.description: True when the producing component dropped findings because a configured limit was reached. Never claim completeness when true.

error.description: Human-readable failure reason when status is error; null otherwise.

path.description: Instance path exactly as supplied on the command line; not canonicalized.

rules_executed.description: Rule families actually executed, in execution order; not a claim of full coverage.

rule.description: Stable rule id such as xbrl-instance:invalid-root or xbrl-validate:unresolved-reference. Renaming is breaking.

severity.description: The three Severity variants of xbrl_core::diagnostic, lowercase.

message.description: Human-readable message; does not contain the rule id or location.

span.description: Half-open byte offsets in the original UTF-8 source, or null for a document-wide finding.
